title: Founder & Program Lead — Social & Behavioral Skills Program (Schools & Families)
description: Developing a social and interpersonal skills program that engages teachers, students, and parents at private and international schools, building the practical people-skills that shape healthier classrooms and homes. Designing school-based strategies that equip teachers and parents to work together on student behavioral challenges and excessive reliance on technology, supporting stronger real-world engagement.

title: Founder — Inner Bloom
description: Founded an initiative supporting teenage girls through safe, healthy psychological growth during adolescence. Delivered a workshop on self-awareness and emotional release for teenage girls in Sharm El-Sheikh (October 2025).

title: Founder — 'A Lifestyle' Sustainable Development Awareness Initiative
description: Built public awareness of everyday practices that support sustainable development, extending the sustainability research behind her award-winning Master's thesis into community practice.

title: Contributor — Women Empowerment Sessions, Beginning (Bedaya) Presidential Initiative
description: Following her Women's Leadership School graduation and drawing on the women's-quality-of-life research in her Master's, ran sessions in Sharm El-Sheikh supporting women's empowerment, health, and family relationships.
